
# More News

> More News is a modern community news reader powered by the Hacker News API.

## About

More News helps users discover the latest stories, discussions, and discoveries from the Hacker News community.

## Features

- Browse top, new, and best stories.
- Explore Ask HN, Show HN, jobs, and polls.
- Sort stories and navigate between pages.
- Open original articles and discussions.

## Useful Links

- [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/)
- [Hacker News API](https://github.com/HackerNews/API)
